Name: Emotive Krobus
Author: Girafarig
Description:
It always annoyed me how Krobus' face never ever changes. It was always the same blank expression. So, ta-da! Now, along with giving a smile when you give him a gift, his aura color will slightly shift as well.

This is an xnb mod, and it couldn't be simpler to install. Locate your content folder, open up you portraits folder, (back-up the current krobus folder) and paste in the new file!  You're done! Again, this is an xnb mod, not a SMAPI mod!

That's it! This doesn't edit his dialogue or any of events, so this you'll mostly see these new portraits just when you're giving him gifts.
